headline: Government approves Rs 1.86 lakh crore Green Energy Corridor-III
hook: Massive grid expansion to support renewable energy
summary: The government has greenlit the Green Energy Corridor-III project with an investment of Rs 1.86 lakh crore. This initiative aims to build transmission infrastructure to integrate renewable energy sources into the national grid. The project focuses on evacuating power from upcoming renewable energy zones to high-demand regions. This infrastructure push is critical for India's target of achieving 500 GW of non-fossil fuel capacity by 2030.

why_it_matters: Boosts long-term order books for power transmission and equipment companies.
winners_losers: Power transmission firms gain / fossil fuel producers hurt

summary: Akhilesh Pathak has officially assumed charge as the Director of Projects at Power Grid Corporation of India. In this role, he will oversee the execution and strategic planning of major transmission projects undertaken by the state-run utility. The appointment brings a new executive head to manage the capital expenditure pipeline of the Maharatna company. For Indian retail investors, leadership stability in execution-heavy firms like Power Grid is crucial for maintaining project timelines and capital allocation efficiency.
why_it_matters: Execution timelines for transmission projects depend on leadership stability.
